verdict.rationale: doola's Registered Agent service gives digital access to physical mail through the doola dashboard. It also offers same-day document scans with secure storage, so the core of scanning legal and state mail into an online account is documented. Read access is implied by 'digital access' but never spelled out, and nothing documents downloading or sharing the scans. Missing for 10: documented download capability, documented sharing capability, explicit in-dashboard viewing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them

citations.quote: Our Registered Agent service enables you to respond quickly by giving you digital access to physical mail via doola's dashboard.
Receive local document scans within the same day and enjoy secure storage for all scanned documents
Legal mail gets an official home from day one.
